column5: DESKTOP IS DONE, THE WHOLE SMALL-SCREEN TIER IS NOT. Verified `match` at desktop: graph panel 9142-18315 (multiplier-history pills measured 1918/2783px vs Figma 1905/2797, trimmed y-axis ticks, exported rocket asset), manual bet panel 9137-13564 (panel LEFT with the order class pinned on both flex children so the dice mirroring bug cannot recur), live-bets header 9142-19454, Auto 9142-16809, Auto Advanced 9142-19197. /play/crash is built (CrashPage + CrashPageSections, every Figma section present top-to-bottom). PARTIAL for one uniform, named gap: 6 of 12 frames have neither a verdict nor a dedicated implementation, and they are all the small-screen tier - 9003-96041 and 9003-98680 (the two rival 768 pages), 9142-15687 (375x812 page), and the three mobile bet-panel states 9156-1198 Mobile Extended LB, 9156-1371 Mobile Auto, 9156-1558 Mobile Auto Advanced. AviatorGamePro.tsx is 3,870 lines and contains exactly ONE responsive branch - a `lg:hidden` at line 2376 that swaps the half-stake chip label - so the mobile panel order and stacking those three frames specify does not exist in code; the page is fluid, not built to the frames. ★ THE GRAPH FRAME RENDERS A MULTIPLIER THE RAIL DOES NOT PAY: the client hardcodes exp(0.15*s) (crashLiveRoundService.ts:725) while the POINTS server settles exp(0.06*s) (_shared/crash.ts:116) - displayed 2.00x pays 1.32x, displayed 100x pays 6.31x, a 15.8x gap at the top; the client also reads the SHARED round multiplier rather than the POINTS round's own startedAt, and the server returns growthK that nothing consumes. ★ THE LIVE SKAI RAIL RUNS 1% EDGE, NOT 5%: migration 20260623222021 set v_house_edge=0.05, then 20260722140000 - a pgcrypto schema-qualifying FIX - did a full CREATE OR REPLACE carrying an older 0.01 body under a header claiming the provably-fair math was UNCHANGED; nothing since restores it (recurring-issues 276). ★ POINTS stakes are silently FORFEIT when the unrelated shared round crashes - stake escrowed, no settle, no seed reveal - and crashSettleAbandoned is imported by nothing in production. Practice-mode toggle omitted per the standing product call.
